title: tooling(pm): fleet-roster.mjs and mailbox-open.mjs read through `gh api --paginate --slurp`, which the built-in gh of cloud sessions refuses — so no cloud seat can regenerate the fleet roster (#25462, stale since 2026-10-23)
body:
Filing gate ③: **maintainer-directed task.** The maintainer, in the triage seat thread on 2026-10-26: asked 「车队总表还对吗」 and read the triage reading (the roster is 2.5 days stale and cannot be regenerated from a cloud session). Of the two recovery options, they chose 「总表怎么恢复 B」: fix the generator so that any session can run it. Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason:** #25462 (车队总表) is the one view of who sits where. Its body was last written 2026-10-23T15:03Z, and since then the lane merge, the ui-merge cutover and several seat changes have made it wrong:
- objectui seats it lists are closed.
- `domain:engine` is now `domain:server`.
- `domain:services` and `domain:cli` are archives, closed 2026-10-26.
- spec seats 2 and 4, skills seats 1 and 2, devx seat 2 and cloud seat 2 have all changed hands.
- It does not show that this repository has no `domain:ui` seat.

Anyone reading it routes work to the wrong place. The fleet runs in cloud sessions, so a generator that only runs with the real GitHub CLI is a generator nobody runs.

**Reader who acts:** `domain:devx` (`scripts/pm/**`), one small PR.

## Measured (`main` `2a728ba2ac`, run from a cloud session)

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` exits 3: `a read failed — GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=open&labels=pm%3Aseat&per_page=100 — gh: --slurp is not supported by this built-in gh.`
- The cause is `ghJson()` in `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`: `spawnSync('gh', ['api', '--paginate', '--slurp', path])`, then `parsed.flat()`.
- `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` uses `--slurp` the same way, so it fails the same way in a cloud session.

## Wanted

- Paginate in the script and not through `gh` flags: `per_page=100&page=N` until a short page, or by following the `Link` header. The built-in gh supports plain `gh api <path>`. The scratchpad tooling the seats already run uses exactly that loop.
- Apply the same to `mailbox-open.mjs`, or move the loop into one shared helper both import.
- The `--self-test` gains a case: a three-page fixture read through the loop equals the slurped array.
- Then one `--write 25462` from a cloud session, to show it end to end. That is one stroke, one body.

## Not in scope

- No change to what the roster shows, or to its columns.
- No change to the relay. The write path (`--write`, `fleet-write`) already works from cloud sessions.
